itemLevel.source: generated item level; clamped on creation and save migration

rankStarMapping.formula: step = min(107, floor(((itemLevel - 1) * 108) / 720)); rankIndex = floor(step / 12); starLevel = (step % 12) + 1
rankStarMapping.rankBands: Each adventurer rank spans 80 item levels.

compatibility.legacyItemRank: Preserved as the existing 1-23 gear-material tier used for base stat steps.
compatibility.rarity: Preserved as the existing 1-9 item rarity tier.
compatibility.migration: Existing equipment receives gearLevel, powerLevel, adventurerRank and starLevel when retierGear runs.
